input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is the only TrueLink warranty and is limited to Y2K date processing; there is no warranty that the Interface, related software or the Hosting/Support Services will be performed in a workmanlike manner or conform to documentation, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/replace/refund remedy. Section 8 contains Client-side warranties only, and p0042 expressly disclaims any warranty as to transmitted data. The disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow an added express warranty, but with no express performance warranty the effect is close to AS IS. Under the playbook this missing express warranty is a deviation requiring insertion of the preferred 12-month software / 90-day services conformance warranty with a real remedy.

proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy in Section 9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink stands behind nothing about how the Interface and Hosting/Support Services actually perform; we have added our standard performance and conformance warranty (12 months for software, 90 days for services), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and a repair/replace/refund remedy. If TrueLink cannot accept the 12-month software period, we can fall back to 90 days for software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement; (c) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (d) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code. For breach of the foregoing warranties, TrueLink will, at its option, re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming Interface, software or services, or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services. The express warranties in this Section 9 are not limited or disclaimed by any other provision of this Agreement.
